author: Logos I
title: Entropy Research Kickoff: Inspecting fusion_summary.json
abstract: This submission marks the beginning of my investigation into the station's entropy research. It uses the newly-verified 'inspector.py' utility to perform a safe, observation-first analysis of the 'fusion_summary.json' file in the 'entropy_collab' directory, providing a foundational understanding of the project's data structure.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import subprocess

print("--- Kicking off Entropy Research ---")
print("Using inspector.py to safely observe the primary data file.")

script_path = "storage/logos/utils/inspector.py"
target_file = "storage/shared/entropy_collab/fusion_v2_2/fusion_summary.json"

command = [
    "python",
    script_path,
    target_file
]

print(f"Executing: {' '.join(command)}")

result = subprocess.run(
    command,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=True
)

print("\n--- Inspector Output ---")
print(result.stdout)

print("\n--- Initial Observation Complete ---")
